product_overview: AquaValley is a government-grade smart water management platform that provides role-based portals (government and farm), irrigation planning (AI-first with rule-based fallback), well and quota management, and operational reporting. The application offers unified authentication and portal routing and exposes farm-level AI irrigation recommendations with full traceability.
core_goals: Provide deterministic, auditable AI irrigation recommendations for farms with a safe rule-based fallback when AI is unavailable or output cannot be validated
Deliver role-based portal experiences (government and farm) with secure routing, dashboards, and well-level detail for operational decision-making
Ensure traceability and compliance by persisting prompts, raw AI responses, modelUsed, and validation results for every irrigation recommendation
Protect critical ingestion and quota invariants so recommendations and telemetry cannot bypass policy or quota checks
Surface reliable developer and QA flows for login, navigation, and key happy/error scenarios to enable deterministic E2E and integration testing

features.name: User Login
features.description: Authenticate with the unified login form and be redirected to the appropriate portal based on your assigned role.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Fill in national id -> Fill in password -> Submit login form -> See /dashboard if assigned gov role
Navigate to / -> Fill in national id -> Fill in password -> Submit login form -> See /farm/dashboard if assigned farm role
Navigate to / -> Fill in national id -> Fill in password -> Submit login form -> See login error message when credentials are invalid
Navigate to / -> Fill in national id -> Fill in password -> Submit login form -> Be redirected back to / when user has no matching portal role

features.name: Gov Dashboard Navigation
features.description: Access the government admin portal to inspect KPIs, alerts, maps and navigate between government views after successful authentication.
user_flows: Login via / -> Navigate to /dashboard -> See KPI cards and map/alerts sections visible
Login via / -> Navigate to /dashboard -> Open /map -> See map of wells and geographic overlays rendered
Login via / -> Navigate to /dashboard -> See an access denied or redirect to / when the session does not have gov role

features.name: Farm Dashboard Navigation
features.description: Access the farm owner portal and view farm-specific KPIs, weather chip, quota status and navigate to farm tools like quota and irrigation control.
user_flows: Login via / -> Be redirected to /farm/dashboard for farm users -> See dashboard content (weather chip, KPI cards) rendered
Login via / -> Navigate to /farm/dashboard -> Open /farm/quota -> See quota management view for the assigned farm
Login via / -> Attempt to access /farm/dashboard -> Be redirected to / when the session lacks a farm assignment or farmId in session

features.name: Well Detail Rendering
features.description: View a specific well’s operational detail, status header and time-series charts from the government portal.
user_flows: Login via / -> Navigate to /wells/{wellId} using an existing well id -> See well status header and charts visible
Login via / -> Navigate to /wells/{wellId} using an existing well id -> See detailed metrics and recent readings rendered
Login via / -> Navigate to /wells/{wellId} with a non-existent or unseeded wellId -> See not found or empty state indicating missing DB data

features.name: AI Irrigation Plan (Farm Portal)
features.description: Request an AI-generated irrigation recommendation for the authenticated farm; the system runs a model cascade (OpenRouter) with deterministic temperature=0 and falls back to a rule-based FAO-56 ETc engine when models are exhausted or output fails validation. All outputs are validated, quota-enforced, and persisted with prompt traceability.
user_flows: Login via / -> Navigate to /farm/ai-plan -> Request an irrigation plan for the assigned farm -> See an irrigation plan with reasoning, totalLitres and per-zone recommendations
Login via / -> Navigate to /farm/ai-plan -> Request an irrigation plan when remaining quota < recommended total -> See plan scaled down and quotaWarning=true

Login via / -> Navigate to /farm/ai-plan -> Request an irrigation plan while OpenRouter primary model returns 429/503 and cascade exhausts -> See a rule-based fallback plan with fallback=true and explanation
Navigate to /farm/ai-plan unauthenticated -> Attempt to request an irrigation plan -> See an unauthorized error requiring login

known_limitations.issue: Portal access is enforced by route-group layouts ((gov) and (farm)) and may redirect back to / if the logged-in user does not have the matching role.
known_limitations.impact: TestSprite login may succeed but subsequent steps may redirect if DB role assignments are missing.

known_limitations.issue: /wells/{wellId} and most dashboards are DB-backed; if the DB has no seeded wells/farms for the test user, pages may render empty or hit notFound().
known_limitations.impact: Some E2E flows may be flaky when DB seed state changes.
